description: This file defines a base class for testing Pluggable Queue Balancer functionality within Orleans streaming tests. It includes methods for verifying queue balancing logic, configuring silo services, and checking lease responsibilities across silos.

classes.name: PluggableQueueBalancerTestBase
classes.description: A base class for testing pluggable queue balancer behavior in Orleans streaming tests.

classes.name: SiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: A nested class implementing ISiloConfigurator to configure silo services for testing.

methods.name: ShouldUseInjectedQueueBalancerAndBalanceCorrectly
methods.description: Asynchronously verifies that the injected queue balancer distributes responsibilities evenly across silos.

methods.name: CheckLeases
methods.description: Checks if the lease responsibilities are correctly assigned to each silo, ensuring balanced load.
